summary.intent: Implement Workstream 2 (PR #634, Entire change #242): a narrowly named best-effort stderr operation for advisories/error cards/subprocess echo, one shared stdout sink handling closed stdout uniformly, and fixed performance/recording-runner tests, written failing-first, then gate, run Codex review, and commit locally without pushing.
summary.outcome: Implemented `advise` (in callisto-graph::note) and a shared BrokenPipe-quiet `Stdout` sink, migrated CLI and graph call sites, fixed the is_active full-history guard, rewrote the process-count oracle with older-version tags and a pre-2.44 legacy tag-listing positive control, and added a changeset and spec entry. pre-push, lint, doc-check and test all exited 0 (2824 passed), but the signed commit and the Codex review rounds were not completed in the transcript: the sandboxed commit failed on gpg and was retried, and no final sha was confirmed.

repo: Advisory stderr is routed through `callisto_graph::note::advise`, re-exported from callisto-cli's output.rs. Both crates enforce it with clippy.toml disallowed print macros and `#![deny(clippy::print_stdout, clippy::print_stderr)]`, replacing a source-scan test.

All stdout goes through `output::stdout()`, a `Stdout<W>` wrapper that treats BrokenPipe as success; `color::stdout()` wraps AutoStream in it. Required writes (prompt_line, reports, receipts) stay fallible.

Git before 2.44 peels a tag-of-tag one level in `for-each-ref %(*objectname)`, so the tag index lacks a commit and later lookups spawn git processes. The tests emulate this with a wrapper git script/runner (`LegacyTagListing`) and a positive control.
A `publish = false` fixture made the process-count test not exercise release resumption; drop it for the positive control.
Running `cd crates/...` made the harness create stray empty `.claude/.cc-writes` dirs under crates/ that break cargo loading; remove them.
Commit signing needs ~/.gnupg, which is blocked in the sandbox, so signed commits must run outside it.
Test harness gained `release_local_command` and `closed_pipe()` (std::io::pipe with the reader dropped) to run the CLI with a closed stderr.

code.finding: The full-history/shallow guard did not check `is_active`, so disabled inference still ran git work. Gating it on `is_active` fixed this, and the new oracle catches the regression (13 vs 11 processes under the legacy listing) while the old test passed.
The oracle now compares Auto against matched Changeset controls at older tag versions (0.9.0), under modern and legacy listings, for 2 and 6 crates.
`Stdout` swallows only BrokenPipe on write/flush; other errors propagate. `advise` ignores any write failure.

friction: Stray `.claude/.cc-writes` directories from the harness broke cargo until removed.
Sandbox blocked gpg signing, so the first commit attempt failed and had to be retried outside it.
The legacy tag-listing wrapper initially had no effect, which required debugging scripts, because `publish = false` skipped the resume path.
A guard blocked inline git outside the worktree, forcing debug scripts into files.
